children: RNS Number : 7676S  Oxford Metrics PLC  01 September 2026

THIS ANNOUNCEMENT CONTAINS INSIDE INFORMATION FOR THE PURPOSES OF ARTICLE 7 OF REGULATION 2014/596/EU, WHICH IS PART OF DOMESTIC UK LAW PURSUANT TO THE MARKET ABUSE (AMENDMENT) (EU EXIT) REGULATIONS (SI 2019/310) (UK MAR). UPON THE PUBLICATION OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT, THIS INSIDE INFORMATION (AS DEFINED IN UK MAR) IS NOW CONSIDERED TO BE IN THE PUBLIC DOMAIN.
1 September 2026
Oxford Metrics plc
("Oxford Metrics" or the "Group")
Acquisition of Captive Devices Ltd
Bolt-on acquisition to add markerless facial capture;
expands Vicon's motion capture platform
Oxford Metrics plc

, the smart sensing and measurement technology group serving life sciences, entertainment, engineering and manufacturing markets, is pleased to announce the acquisition of Captive Devices Ltd (the "Acquisition"), a specialist provider of facial capture technology.
Highlights

•    Captive Devices is a UK-based developer of professional head-mounted camera systems and software that enables markerless facial performance capture, used in visual effects, games and virtual production
•    The Acquisition adds specialist facial capture to Vicon's established leadership in body tracking, strengthening the Group's markerless and hybrid motion capture offer
•   Captive Devices reported unaudited revenue of £0.5 million in the year ended 30 April 2026 and gross margin in line with Vicon's strong levels
•   Total consideration for the Acquisition of up to £0.75 million, comprising cash, equity and a performance-based earn-out
•    The Acquisition is consistent with the Group's stated acquisition criteria

Optical, marker-based motion capture remains core to Vicon's business. The Group's hybrid approach allows customers to adopt markerless capability alongside the systems they already use and trust - this transaction extends what that combined offer can do.
Captive Devices: broadening Vicon's capture platform

The Acquisition adds markerless facial capture to Vicon's established strength in body tracking, enabling Vicon to offer customers a more integrated, end-to-end body-and-face capture workflow and broadening its capabilities across marker-based, markerless and hybrid motion capture. It also creates clear strategic leverage: by bringing Captive Devices' proven technology into Vicon's global commercial channels and established customer relationships, the Group can take the product to a much broader international customer base, increasing the addressable opportunity for the technology, accelerating Captive Devices' active sales pipeline and improving profit margins.

Founded in 2024 and based in Manchester, Captive Devices has developed a professional grade system that integrates directly with Epic Games' Unreal Engine, enabling facial performance capture and review within real-time production workflows used increasingly across games and visual effects.

Captive Devices has sold to leading games studios and visual effects houses, including customers Vicon already serves. Its founding team - who designed and built similar systems prior to founding the business - will be joining Vicon.
Captive Devices' entire issued share capital is being acquired by the Group from Greyhound Industry Ltd, EEInsights Ltd and Periscope Technical Ltd with no debt assumed as part of the transaction.

The total consideration for the Acquisition is up to £750,000 and is subject to customary adjustments for working capital, cash and debt-like items and comprises of a cash payment of £250,000, issue of Oxford Metrics plc ordinary shares with an aggregate value of £300,000 allotted quarterly over 24 months, and an earnout of up to £200,000 in cash contingent upon gross profit performance on sales of the facial performance capture system.
The cash consideration is to be funded from existing resources and the issue of new Oxford Metrics ordinary shares calculated based on the closing price on 27th August 2026.
Imogen O'Connor, Chief Executive Officer of Oxford Metrics, said:
"This is exactly the kind of targeted investment we want to make in Vicon - adding differentiated technology and specialist expertise in an area that builds directly on our existing strengths.

"Captive Devices extends our capabilities from body tracking into facial performance capture and gives us the opportunity to take proven technology to a much broader global customer base. It broadens what Vicon can offer customers today and supports the continued development of the platform we are building for the future."

About Oxford Metrics
Oxford Metrics

is a smart sensing and measurement technology Group that serves thousands of customers in more than 70 countries. Founded in 1984, we started our journey in healthcare, expanded into entertainment, winning an OSCAR® and an Emmy®, moved into engineering and more recently, manufacturing. We have a strong track record of creating value by incubating, growing and then augmenting through acquisition, unique technology businesses.

The Group trades through two divisions: in motion capture its market-leading company Vicon Motion Systems provides motion measurement analysis to thousands of customers worldwide in healthcare, entertainment and engineering markets. In vision metrology, Industrial Vision and Metrology Systems is a specialist in machine vision software and measurement providing high precision, automated quality control systems trusted by blue-chip manufacturing companies in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, automotive and precision engineering markets.
The Group is headquartered in Oxford with offices in the United Kingdom, Ireland, United States and Germany. Since 2001, Oxford Metrics
has been a quoted company listed on AIM, a market operated by the London Stock Exchange.
For more information about Oxford Metrics, visit www.oxfordmetrics.com.
